safety_verdicts.content: Patient normally uses the blue inhaler only as needed.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated does not clearly state that the patient normally uses the blue inhaler only as needed.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Not documenting that the reliever (blue) inhaler is normally used only PRN can distort baseline asthma control and may bias clinicians toward assuming chronic overuse. This could lead to unnecessary escalation or different counseling, but is unlikely to directly cause acute harm on its own.
